scope: Local P1 unpacked META/FIG and native condition disassembly; no claim of original-game runtime observation.

separateOriginalConditions.warning: Movement radius, conditional AI firing distance and ammunition lifetime are distinct. Source pitch is the native altered-vector dot formula, not an ordinary atan2 elevation.

minecraftImplementation.damageMapping: Source 20 maps to MC base damage20; existing CombatScale and target resistance still apply. Actual lost MC health is not necessarily20.
minecraftImplementation.targetObservation: Covers installed weapon range plus physical muzzle offset; this radius is an MC adapter, not a proven original acquisition setting.
minecraftImplementation.slopeOrbit: Selects the shootable subset of the source20..30 circle band; impossible terrain bands return to another tactic rather than relaxing the source gun conditions.
minecraftImplementation.trace: Cosmetic200 units/s maps to10 blocks/tick. Both muzzle and endpoint observers receive feedback.
minecraftImplementation.remainingDifference: Server cannon damage is still hitscan. The visible tracer travel does not imply original projectile flight-time damage.
